mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative or flat 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the average 20-day return is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% per annum signals a tightening monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates strong underlying demand growth, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 103.0 indicates weakening supply-side capacity, which signals economic slowdown and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 103.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with a stable or rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand and confidence, which drives corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to generate positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the joint effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 238.5 with a concurrent increase in the federal funds rate signals inflationary pressures that prompt the Fed to tighten policy, increasing risk-free rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 144,000 thousand combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a rapidly tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 16500 billion of chained 2017 dollars signals a contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenues and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 < 16500, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
